pages.lesson:
LESSON: LOCATION, POSITION AND SIZE OF KENYA

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and Historic Built Environments
Topic 1.2: Location, Position and Size of Kenya

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Location, Position and Size of Kenya. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is the position of Kenya in relation to her neighbours?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify countries that neighbour Kenya

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify countries that neighbour Kenya
   In simple words: practise until you can identify countries that neighbour Kenya. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Location, Position and Size of Kenya using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Location, Position and Size of Kenya in the examples.
2. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
4. Show that you can: identify countries that neighbour Kenya

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Location, Position and Size of Kenya using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Location, Position and Size of Kenya important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Draw a map of Kenya and indicate her neighbours,
2. Acquire knowledge on their country as they discuss the position of Kenya in relation to her neighbours,
3. Use appropriate media, in pairs, to play games on locating places on a map,
4. Find out the size of Kenya using digital resources and share in class,
5. Draw a map of Kenya and indicate the size in square kilometres, What is the position of Kenya in relation to her neighbours? 4

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify countries that neighbour Kenya

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
